title: Asynchronous Request Sampled Without Synchronizer
bug_signature: UVM_ERROR: [META] gnt=4'bxxxx; req sampled at clock edge without synchronizer
rtl: assign gnt = req & mask;  // req is asynchronous — metastability risk at clock edge
expected_root_cause: The request signal req arrives from an asynchronous clock domain and is used directly in combinational grant logic without a synchronizer; when req transitions near posedge clk the sampled value is metastable and gnt becomes unknown.
description: The request signal from an asynchronous source is used directly in combinational grant logic without a synchronizer, causing metastability when req transitions near the clock edge.
failure_log: UVM_ERROR: [META] gnt=4'bxxxx; req sampled at clock edge without synchronizer
success_log: req_sync stable. gnt clean after 2-cycle synchronizer latency.
